jobs_results.job_title: Marketing Analytics & Data Science Senor Lead
jobs_results.description:
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward - always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.


The Role
The Marketing Analytics & Data Science Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for advancing Kyndryl’s marketing measurement, audience intelligence, and predictive analytics capabilities. This role serves as the analytical engine behind marketing strategy, helping the organization better understand buyer behavior, optimize investment decisions, and improve marketing’s contribution to revenue growth.


This role combines deep analytical expertise with business acumen to solve complex marketing challenges through advanced analytics, attribution methodologies, predictive modeling, and audience insights. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing actionable recommendations that influence strategic marketing decisions across channels, audiences, and the customer lifecycle.


Working closely with marketing leaders, campaign teams, digital teams, operations, sales, and data engineering, this role will identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness through data-driven decision making, and advanced analytical techniques.


Key Responsibilities
Marketing Measurement & Attribution
Lead the evolution of marketing measurement frameworks and attribution methodologies that quantify marketing’s contribution to pipeline, revenue, and business growth.


Develop and evaluate multi-touch attribution approaches, influence measurement strategies, and channel contribution models that guide investment decisions and budget optimization.


Identify measurement gaps and recommend improvements in data collection, metadata strategies, campaign tagging, and platform integrations to improve reporting accuracy and analytical rigor.


Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling
Design and develop predictive models that improve marketing effectiveness, including response scoring, buyer propensity models, lead prioritization, audience engagement models, and lifecycle analysis.


Apply statistical techniques, machine learning methodologies, and AI-enabled approaches to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities hidden within large marketing and sales datasets.


Translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that improve conversion rates, pipeline generation, audience engagement, and marketing ROI.


Audience Insights & Segmentation
Develop audience segmentation frameworks that support account-based marketing, customer expansion strategies, digital engagement programs, and campaign personalization.


Analyze customer, account, behavioral, technographic, and engagement data to identify growth opportunities and uncover actionable audience insights.


Analytics Strategy & Thought Leadership
Serve as a subject matter expert on advanced analytics, marketing measurement, and data science methodologies within the marketing organization.


Drive innovation by evaluating emerging analytical techniques, AI capabilities, and measurement approaches that improve marketing effectiveness and operational efficiency.


Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to senior marketing leaders and stakeholders, translating complex methodologies into clear business actions.


Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof ofvaccinationto align with their respective COVID-19vaccinationpolicies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.


Who You Are
Key Competencies

Advanced analytical problem solving
Statistical reasoning and experimentation design
Predictive modeling and machine learning
Marketing measurement and attribution expertise
Strategic thinking and business acumen
Executive communication and storytelling
Intellectual curiosity and innovation
Independent ownership and accountability
Cross-functional influence without formal authority
Passion for translating data into measurable business impact

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, revenue operations, business analytics, or related analytical disciplines.
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across large and complex datasets.
Strong proficiency with Python, R, or comparable analytical and visualization platforms.
Experience developing predictive models, scoring methodologies, segmentation frameworks, or statistical analyses used in business decision making.
Strong understanding of attribution methodologies, funnel measurement, and marketing performance evaluation.
Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, data warehouse, and digital measurement platforms.
Ability to independently scope, lead, and deliver complex analytical projects from problem definition through implementation.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Experience leveraging AI and machine learning techniques to automate analyses, accelerate insight generation, or improve business outcomes.

Prefered Qualifications

Masters degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
Strong proficiency with Power BI

Being You
Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it's how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect
With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter - wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learningprograms give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, includingMicrosoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

jobs_results.description: Risepoint is an education technology company that helps regional universities launch and grow online programs for modern learners. Risepoint supports more than 100 universities and colleges across five countries, with programs concentrated in high-demand fields including nursing, healthcare, teaching, business, technology, and public service. Our suite of products and services supports the full student journey and each university’s long-term goals. Together, we increase access to affordable education that delivers a strong return on investment for learners and meets employer and community needs. Learn more at risepoint.com. About This Opportunity As a Strategy & Analytics Co-op, you will play a meaningful role in the Marketing & Operations, Strategy & Analytics team, partnering closely with analytics team to help shape the future of the organization through data-driven insights and strategic thinking. In this role, you’ll collaborate across functions and gain exposure to a wide range of stakeholders—including senior leaders—while contributing to projects that influence key business decisions. Co-op Duration This opportunity runs from January 2027 through June 2027, with some flexibility on start and end to accommodate academic schedules. Weekly Schedule This is a full-time co-op experience, 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, designed to provide hands-on, real-world exposure. The Impact You Will Make As a Strategy & Analytics Co-op, you’ll work on high-impact, fast-paced projects that support meaningful business outcomes while accelerating your professional growth. You’ll gain exposure to core strategy and analytics disciplines, including data analysis, marketing strategy, and operational processes across product, marketing, revenue, and enrollment services. With mentorship from senior leaders, you’ll help conduct analyses that inform Risepoint’s strategic direction. Working cross-functionally, you’ll structure analyses, develop hypotheses, and deliver actionable, value-added recommendations that drive business growth. How You Will Bring Our Mission to Life What You Will Do Structure strategic projects for key products, marketing, strategy, revenue, and enrollment services functions Execute end-to-end data analytics projects by 1) pulling/cleaning data, 2) extracting key insights, 3) communicating hypotheses to senior stakeholders, and 4) impacting our organization’s overall marketing strategies & operations functions Design and create analytical tools, strategic initiatives, and processes that boost our organization’s ability to deliver insights both internally to senior leadership and externally to our university partners Contribute to Risepoint's AI-first analytical practices by incorporating tools like Claude and Databricks Genie into day-to-day workflows to accelerate analysis and communication; AI is a productivity tool here, not a replacement for analytical judgment, and the expectation is full ownership of and accountability for the work product Brainstorm and launch new projects to proactively detect KPIs and inform our university partners about strategic issues, performance, and operations Form a deep understanding of Risepoint’s processes, systems/tools, personnel, strategic direction, and broader market ecosystem (university partners, marketing channels, contact center strategies and workflows) Collaborate cross-functionally with senior Directors and VPs to communicate data insights and make data-informed decisions You will work closely with a Director, Manager, and Analysts What Success Looks Like Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex concepts and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels Strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects simultaneously Great ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams and maintain analytical accuracy under time pressure; you validate before you publish and catch discrepancies before they reach stakeholders. Collaborative problem-solving mindset and the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, driving change through analytical insights How Impact Will be Measured Impact is measured by the ability to deliver strategic insights that directly influence our clients’ marketing and operations functions You will also grow in your ability to independently manage and execute data analytics projects What You’ll Bring to the Team Experience That Matters Most Applicants must be active, enrolled students in Spring 2027 to apply for this position. Strong proficiency and/or working experience in Databricks, SQL, Excel modeling, and data analysis Demonstrated ability to conceive and execute quantitative analysis and deliver data-driven insights Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Applicants must be currently enrolled, active students in Fall 2026 to apply for this position Experience That’s Great to Have Prior working experience using Databricks, SQL, Excel modeling, and data analysis to clean data, extract insights, and communicate takeaways to leadership Prior internship / co-op experience preferred Agile workstyle to meet evolving business needs in a dynamic and fast-paced work environment that RisePoint is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse and inclusive workforce Reliable. Empowered. Adaptable. Customer-centric. Heart. These are some of the words that describe Risepoint employees. We have spent the past nearly 20 years helping universities grow by expanding access to affordable, life-changing education for working adults. As an education technology company that provides trusted partnership and expertise to more than 125 universities and colleges, we primarily work with regional universities, helping them create online programs in critical areas such as nursing, teaching, business, and public service. We are dedicated to increasing access to affordable education so that more students can improve their careers and their communities.

jobs_results.description:
Senior Marketing Analyst

Automotive Retail (Hybrid, Phoenix, AZ)




📊 $100,000 to $115,000 base plus a performance bonus. Lead marketing analytics and help decide where the next marketing dollar should go.




Cactus Jack's Auto is hiring a Senior Marketing Strategy Analyst to help shape marketing decisions across its growing automotive retail business in Arizona and Texas. The company sells cars and finances and services its own loans, so marketing results depend on inventory, approvals, credit quality and customer value over time.




The company expects to nearly double the size of the business over the next 14 months, with a ten-year plan to grow several times larger. As marketing scales, this position will help shape how the company measures performance and where it invests.




The Opportunity

This is a strategy role built on technical depth. You'll set direction, and you'll need to understand how marketing data moves from first click to funded loan well enough to design it and catch when it breaks. Strong data and marketing analytics fundamentals are a requirement, because you can't build good strategy on numbers you can't trust.




You'll report to the Head of Data & Analytics and work with marketing, operations and developers. You decide how marketing data should flow; developers build it, and you check that it works. The analytics team works AI-first and values the judgment to know when to challenge an answer. Writing SQL is not required.




What You Will Do

Map the full funnel from ad click through application, approval and delivery.Own attribution, evaluate the current setup and define conversion signals for Google and Meta.Design and evaluate website conversion tests and report what changed.Connect email and SMS performance to approvals and deliveries.Recommend changes to spend and customer communication that account for inventory, approvals and customer quality.


Your First 120 Days

Start by learning the funnel, data and attribution setup. By day 120, priorities include owning marketing measurement, website testing and email and SMS reporting, and helping launch remarketing for returning customers. The team will discuss the full plan in the first interview.




Required Qualifications

Experience in marketing analytics, growth or performance marketing tying spend to sales, revenue or customer value.Hands-on work with paid media, attribution and website testing, plus email and SMS marketing.Understanding how data moves between ad platforms, a website, a CRM and a warehouse, and how to identify failures.Daily use of AI in analysis, including providing context and checking its output.Experience making recommendations that changed leadership decisions about marketing or spend.


Preferred Qualifications

Automotive, lending or multi-location retail experience is helpful. Automotive experience is not required. Familiarity with Google Ads, Meta, GA4, PostHog, HYROS, BigQuery or dbt is helpful.




Who Thrives Here

Humble, hungry and smart. You care more about getting it right than being right, teach yourself what you need and investigate when a number doesn't add up. Tools can be learned. Character can't.




Location and Travel

Full-time, hybrid in Phoenix, with one to two office days a week and some travel to dealership locations, including Texas.




Compensation

$100,000 to $115,000 base salary, plus a performance bonus.




💻 How to Apply

Use the application link in this post. The application includes four short written answers and a PDF resume.




Bring your analytical depth, strategic judgment and curiosity to the conversation.

Title:  Senior Marketing Operations Analyst



Global Title:  Sr. Marketing Operations Analyst



Division & Department:  Corporate Operations



Status:  Full-Time Exempt



Reports to:  Director, Marketing Operations



Location:  Remote – Anywhere in the contiguous US (Greater Salt Lake City, Utah preferred)



Compensation:  Anticipated compensation for this position is $89-116k*.



Date Posted:  10/13/2026**



Job Summary



The Senior Marketing Operations Analyst owns end-to-end marketing performance measurement, reporting, and analysis using Domo, Salesforce, and HubSpot to deliver accurate, timely, and actionable insight. This role designs and maintains the core dashboards and data models, defines and governs the KPI and attribution logic behind how marketing performance is measured, and partners across marketing, marketing operations, operations, Salesforce, and finance to support forecasting, budget and ROI analysis, and ad hoc analysis. The Senior Marketing Operations Analyst translates complex data into clear recommendations for marketing leadership and executive stakeholders.



Essential Job Functions




Marketing Data Architecture & Integration: Architect, build, and maintain marketing analytics infrastructure in Domo. This includes designing scalable data models, creating automated data flows, and managing API integrations with key systems like Salesforce and HubSpot to ensure data is accurate, reliable, and consistent across all platforms.


Dashboarding & Reporting: Create and manage a suite of marketing dashboards and reports that deliver clear, actionable insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring data quality by identifying discrepancies and gaps across various Martech tools. Ensuring data is refreshed on schedule and easily understood.


Analysis & Stakeholder Support: Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for marketing leaders and executive stakeholders. Build and manage intuitive dashboards, present findings and recommendations, and serve as the primary contact for all marketing analytics, by proactively flagging emerging trends and risks to the marketing team.


Performance Analysis & Optimization: Proactively monitor funnel, channel, and campaign performance (MQL, attribution, and ROI) to identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and bring forward a point of view and recommendation to marketing leadership.


Strategic Forecasting & ROI Measurement: Partner closely with Enterprise Marketing and Finance leaders to develop forecasts for key funnel metrics, inform budget planning, and measure marketing ROI. This includes reconciling marketing attribution data with financial reporting to create a unified view of performance and investment impact.




Basic Qualifications




Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field


5+ years in marketing analytics, marketing operations, or a closely related analytics role




Preferred Skills & Experience




Experience with marketing operations and/or analytics in a B2B environment


Hands-on experience with Domo (or a comparable BI/visualization tool) for data modeling, dashboards, and reporting


Strong SQL skills for querying and transforming data across multiple sources


Hands-on Salesforce reporting experience (leads, opportunities, pipeline) and advanced Excel (formulas and pivot tables)


Experience with marketing-specific analytics: MQL and funnel-stage definitions, conversion analysis, channel and campaign performance, and efficiency metrics (CPL, cost per MQL, etc.)


Experience with API-based integrations between marketing/sales tools and BI platforms


Experience building and maintaining reports in HubSpot or a similar marketing automation platform


Proven ability to manage data quality and governance and to define KPI standards with cross-functional partners


Familiarity with web and digital analytics concepts (UTMs, campaign tracking, basic web analytics)


Track record of proactively initiating analysis and providing problem solving business cases for key stakeholders


Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex data to non-technical and executive audiences




Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, HSA, employee stock purchasing program, 401(k), paid time off, holiday pay, and more. Please visit https://franklincoveybenefits.com/ for details.



*Actual offer may be outside of this range and will be determined by education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as geographic location, internal equity and alignment with market data.

We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that's why we're inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs.

The Target Pay Range for this position is $99,330 - $124,000 annually. At Antech, pay decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job-related skills, experience, education, training and budget.

Job Purpose/Overview

The Performance Marketing & Analytics Manager will serve as the primary owner of marketing analytics and performance measurement, transforming data into clear, actionable insights that drive stronger business performance. This role owns attribution, ROI measurement, customer journey analytics, and closed-loop reporting across Marketing, Sales, and Product.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and optimize marketing performance measurement frameworks to evaluate campaign effectiveness, pipeline contribution, lead generation, customer acquisition, and revenue impact.Build and manage marketing dashboards, scorecards, and executive reporting using business intelligence and visualization tools to provide actionable insights to marketing and business leaders.Analyze marketing campaign performance across digital, email, paid media, events, content marketing, and demand generation programs, identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates, engagement, and return on investment.Partner with Marketing, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Business leaders to define key performance indicators (KPIs), establish reporting requirements, and ensure alignment between marketing objectives and business outcomes.Own marketing reporting and analytics within Salesforce and HubSpot, including campaign tracking, lead attribution, funnel analysis, lifecycle reporting, opportunity influence, and pipeline performance measurement.Develop and maintain lead funnel reporting, tracking prospects from initial engagement through marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), sales-qualified leads (SQLs), opportunities, and closed-won business.Monitor and analyze lead quality, campaign effectiveness, customer acquisition trends, and pipeline velocity to provide recommendations that improve marketing and sales performance.Create and manage attribution models to measure marketing's contribution to revenue and support strategic investment decisions across marketing channels and programs.Ensure data integrity, consistency, and governance across Salesforce, HubSpot, marketing automation platforms, and reporting systems through regular audits and process improvements.Collaborate with Revenue Operations and Sales teams to improve CRM data quality, campaign tracking standards, lead routing processes, and reporting methodologies.Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities through advanced analysis of customer, campaign, web, and sales data, translating findings into actionable business recommendations.Conduct ad hoc analyses and deep-dive investigations to support business decisions, budget planning, forecasting, and strategic marketing initiatives.Utilize tools such as Power BI, Excel, Google Analytics, Salesforce, HubSpot, and other analytics platforms to automate reporting and improve visibility into marketing performance.Support annual planning processes by providing performance insights, forecasting models, benchmark data, and recommendations for marketing investment optimization.Present findings, recommendations, and performance insights to marketing leadership and cross-functional stakeholders in a clear, concise, and business-focused manner.Continuously evaluate emerging analytics technologies, measurement methodologies, and best practices to enhance reporting capabilities and decision-making effectiveness.Education and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.3-5 years of experience in marketing analytics, performance marketing, revenue marketing, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.Experience developing marketing attribution models, performance measurement frameworks, and ROI reporting.Hands-on experience with Salesforce and HubSpot is required, including campaign tracking, lead lifecycle management, pipeline reporting, and marketing-to-sales performance analysis.Experience working with CRM systems, marketing automation platforms, web analytics tools, and business intelligence solutions.Demonstrated experience translating complex data into actionable business insights and recommendations.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with expertise in KPI development, attribution modeling, forecasting, and performance measurement.Proficiency with Power BI, Google Analytics, Excel, and data visualization tools.Strong working knowledge of Salesforce and HubSpot, including reporting, dashboard creation, campaign performance analysis, lead management, and CRM data governance. Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and data storytelling skills.Travel

As required.

Antech is a leader in veterinary diagnostics, driven by our passion for innovation that delivers better animal health outcomes. Our products and services span 90+ reference laboratories around the globe; in-house diagnostic laboratory instruments and consumables, including rapid assay diagnostic products and digital cytology services; local and cloud-based data services; practice information management software and related software and support; veterinary imaging and technology; veterinary professional education and training; and board-certified specialist support services.
